Class ReplayBenchmarkService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.ReplayBenchmarkService
@Service public class ReplayBenchmarkService extends Object
Compares the equity curve of a completed historical replay with a benchmark, on request and without storing anything. The comparison is built by the same BenchmarkResultFactory as the period performance report, with the flow timing and the annualization rule of the replay metrics.

  • Method Details

    • compare

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public Optional<ReplayBenchmarkComparison> compare(Integer idSimTenant, Integer idBenchmark)
      Compares the latest completed replay of a simulation environment with a benchmark.
      Parameters:
      idSimTenant - the simulation environment, which must belong to the caller
      idBenchmark - null for the stored benchmark of the environment or, without one, of its main client; 0 for none; otherwise the instrument, which must be readable for the main client
      Returns:
      the comparison, empty when the replay has no completed curve or no benchmark resolves
